[SWS_DM_01582] Healing counter increment
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
If the
DiagnosticOperationCycle
of the
DiagnosticEvent
mapped by
Diag-
nosticEventToOperationCycleMapping
is restarted and the
event status
bit
TestFailedThisOperationCycle and TestNotCompletedThisOperationCycle both are set
to 0, the DM shall increment the healing counter by 1.
⌋
